name: Breaga
text: Breaga appears in the Lebor Gabala as a son of Breogan. He is the uncle of Mil Espáine according to the pseudo-history. Perhaps the petty kingdom Brega of east central Ireland took its name from him. The region held weight in early times.

okr.objective: This entry explains the figure Breaga in the pseudo-history Lebor Gabala and his possible link to the region of Brega.
